text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right! Placed on the board, at least!
Palmer-san did a great job, yup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~ no good! That didn't count!
Ugh~, so close... but man,
losing still stings~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Not to sound full of myself, but...
I really think there was a scenario where I took 1st place."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Guess I got lost somewhere along the way.
Like, I couldn't cut loose completely.
choice_data_list: Next time, let's cast all our doubts aside!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, you say the nicest things!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I think so too.
So, we'll definitely get it next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All right... let's do this! Out on the turf, I'm going to be freer than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The girls racing, the spectators, the Trainer...
I'm gonna glue EV-ER-Y single pair of eyes right onto me, I tell ya!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yeah, you're right! Next time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I feel like I'm really building up my strength.
So, after that, it's all down to my own mindset!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I want to be able to finish running and say, "Today was awesome!"...
So let's give it all we've got!
